name: Divinity Mount
text:
Lightning Breath 1: When this unit is declared as an attacker, you may deal 1 damage to all units a target opponent controls.

* Queen Rider: When this unit is destroyed, place 3 wounds on your Phoenixborn.

name: Hand of Shield
text: Unit Guard: This unit may guard a unit that is being attacked.

name: Ptera Hatchling
text: Shock 1: When this unit is declared as an attacker, if its current attack value is greater than its printed attack value, you may deal 1 damage to a target unit an opponent controls.

name: Shining Stag Mount
text:
Armed: When this unit comes into play, you may choose a divine die in your exhausted pool and resolve its dice power without paying its cost.

* Dismount: When this unit is destroyed, place any allies you own underneath this unit into your hand.

name: Summon Shining Stag Mount
text: [[side]] - [[exhaust]] - 1 [[divine:class]] - 1 [[basic]]: Remove an unexhausted ally you control from play. If you do, place a [[Shining Stag Mount]] conjuration onto your battlefield, placing that ally face down underneath it.
